kind_of_thing.quote: Kentrosaurus ( KEN-troh-SOR-əs; lit. 'prickle lizard') is a genus of stegosaurid dinosaur from the Late Jurassic in Lindi Region of Tanzania.

kind_of_dinosaur.quote: It had a small, elongated head with a beak used to bite off plant material that would be digested in a large gut.

dinosaur_group.quote: It had a, probably double, row of small plates running down its neck and back.
